content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] [article_no] along with the [product_name] Basic Starterkit. Does anyone happen to have the original applications that were initially loaded onto the [product_name] and the [product_name] panel?
Which original applications are you referring to?
That's a valid question. I assumed there might have been a preinstalled demo when the devices were shipped.
To my knowledge, such an 'original' demo is not provided. I'm unsure what a default demo would consist of either.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking whether demo applications come preinstalled with the [product_name] [article_no] and [product_name] Basic Starterkit. There appears to be uncertainty about whether sample programs are included, as there is no information in user resources confirming their presence. This lack of clarity may create confusion for new users who expect initial example projects to aid in setup and learning.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that demo programs or example applications will be provided with the [product_name] [article_no] and [product_name] Basic Starterkit for easier initial setup and learning.
